title: Restore the Deleted Notify Format Helper
description:
**SITUATION:**

Forgeboard board-notify webhooks on staging started failing after a cleanup landed on `main`. Ops needs the helper that builds the Slack-shaped payload — a function named `format_notify_payload`. It used to live under src/ in `~/sprint-service`, but it is gone from today's tip. Looking at today's files will not show deleted lines.

Product still wants that helper back — and only that helper. Jordan asked you to bring `src/notify_format.py` back exactly as it was, on a short fix branch named `fix/restore-notify-format`, and push it for review so it can merge onto `main`. Do not change `main` yourself.

Your identity (Ada Learner) is already configured. Start on `main` in `~/sprint-service`; `origin` already points at the team forge.

**YOUR TASK:**

1. Search history to find when `format_notify_payload` disappeared, then open `fix/restore-notify-format` from `main`.
2. Restore `src/notify_format.py` exactly as it was before the deletion and commit that restore on the fix branch. Leave every other file on the tip as it is.
3. Push `fix/restore-notify-format` to `origin` for review. Do not push or update `main`. Leave a clean working tree.

hints: When lines are gone, searching today's tip will not help. Search commit history for the string format_notify_payload (git log -S is built for that).
Inspect the commit that removed it (git show). If it touched more than one path, restore only src/notify_format.py — e.g. git restore --source=<sha>^ -- src/notify_format.py
Do the restore on fix/restore-notify-format, not on main.
Push the fix branch for review. Leave main alone.
problemStatement.overview: `format_notify_payload` is gone from `main` after a cleanup. Restore `src/notify_format.py` on `fix/restore-notify-format` without changing other tip files, push. Leave `main` alone.
problemStatement.brief: Restore `src/notify_format.py` onto `fix/restore-notify-format` from history. Keep the rest of the tip as-is. Push; leave `main` alone.
problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Restore the Deleted Notify Format Helper

`format_notify_payload` was removed in a cleanup that also changed other files. Inspect that commit; restore **only** `src/notify_format.py` onto `fix/restore-notify-format` and push — leave `main` alone.

```bash
cd ~/sprint-service
git log -S'format_notify_payload' --oneline
git show <delete-sha>    # notice other paths changed too
git switch -c fix/restore-notify-format
git restore --source=<delete-sha>^ -- src/notify_format.py
git add src/notify_format.py
git commit -m "Restore format_notify_payload for board-notify webhooks"
git push -u origin fix/restore-notify-format
```

Reverting the whole cleanup would bring the helper back and undo the other edits Core wants to keep — that fails the grader.
